cuda.gpu_name: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Ti Laptop GPU

meta.forward_and_backward_includes: zero_grad(set_to_none), input grad reset, attention forward, float32 mean-square synthetic loss and backward; excludes optimizer/data generation/routing inspection

limitations: Matched production GQA/reference/grouped comparisons use the same run, weights, input, dtype and device. Older JSONs remain historical baselines, not this comparison's denominator.
MiTA approximates dense attention; matching projections does not imply identical GQA and MiTA functions. Reference/grouped equivalence is checked separately.
Reference arithmetic N(2m+k) is not grouped padded SDPA work. Grouped interactions use observed packed_query_slots; both omit projections, packing/sorting/top-k and framework overhead.
Reference-only query-local KV gather capacity is not a grouped buffer or an allocator peak. Measured CUDA allocator fields are separate.
CUDA allocator peaks exclude reserved cache, driver, other processes and non-PyTorch allocations. Timings include synchronization overhead and depend on load.
Synthetic attention/model workload; no Agent task-quality or universal speed claim.

mita_grouped.note: grouped final joint SDPA recomputes shared query-landmark logits and includes padding slots; reference N(2m+k) is not its actual score count

tensor_capacities.note: fused SDPA need not materialize logical scores; grouped does not create reference-style per-query [N,k,d] KV gathers

tensor_capacities.applies_to: common compression/routing plus explicitly reference-only per-query KV gathers; grouped capacities are reported separately from actual routing diagnostics
tensor_capacities.caveat: Several intermediates may coexist. Backward may retain tensors from every chunk. Dense optimized SDPA may avoid materializing its full logical score matrix. These values do not measure either allocator or process peak memory.
